# Reed Creative Labs

> Reed Creative Labs is a veteran-founded, family-built independent software and engineering studio in South Carolina. Its mission is to build software that explores complex systems through desktop tools, scientific simulation, procedural media, games, and focused client work.

Products described as Launching Soon, Final Testing, Active Development, Prototype, Research, Private Beta, or Concept are not released products. Launching Soon indicates release preparation, not current availability. Final Testing indicates testing before release, not a completed launch. Product pages state the current public development status and known platform scope.

The public website is a static Next.js App Router application built with React and TypeScript. Its homepage includes a procedurally generated visualization whose canonical state system is authored in modern Fortran and compiled to WebAssembly; browser code handles lifecycle and rendering. Product pages distinguish working screenshots from abstract or unavailable media.

## Primary Products

- [Forgefield](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/forgefield): RCL's flagship Windows application for procedural live wallpapers and screensavers, with nine native-rendered worlds. Launching Soon; not yet released.
- [Phase Arcade Volume I](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/phase-arcade-volume-1): Three focused arcade games for traditional desktop play and VR: Phase Shift, Phase Breaker, and Phase Court. Final Testing; not yet released.
- [Project Load Bearing](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/project-load-bearing): A major development focus connecting a structural construction-and-testing prototype in Unreal Engine to a native Fortran static frame solver. Active Development for Windows; no release date announced.
- [Static Drift](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/static-drift): An offline procedural ambient application with optional built-in sound and remote-friendly controls. Active Development for Android TV; not yet released.
